metadata.public_bundle_note: Source path sanitized for public dashboard bundle.

components.Shock Pulse: classifier for daily high negative sales deviation during weather stress
components.Recovery Clock: classifier for delayed or incomplete event-window recovery
components.Triage Score: decision-support score combining predicted shock risk, recovery risk, and scar score

split_policy.shock_pulse: fixed chronological split: train through 2025-10-31, validation through 2025-11-30, test in 2025-12
split_policy.recovery_clock: fractional chronological split over available heavy-rain event dates because events do not span all months

model_card.leakage_policy: daily targets and loss estimates use train-period region-industry-weekday median baselines; same-day sales-derived columns are labels/outcomes and excluded from Shock Pulse features; lag/history features are strictly shifted before the prediction row

performance_framing.weather_conditioned_note: Weather-conditioned Shock is a rare-target weather-filtered view. Present PR-AUC, precision, base rate, and top-k recall before ROC-AUC; do not describe high ROC-AUC as near-perfect prediction.
performance_framing.primary_metric_note: Use ROC-AUC, F1, and recall/precision tradeoff rather than accuracy alone because the majority baseline has high accuracy but zero positive-class F1.
performance_framing.recovery_clock_note: Recovery Clock remains exploratory because event samples are smaller and the signal is broad; it is downweighted in triage even when tuned F1 is competitive with the majority baseline.
performance_framing.loss_priority_note: Loss Priority ranks rows for support triage by combining log-scale predicted baseline-relative loss with Shock Pulse risk. Judge it primarily by top-k loss capture and lift, not calibrated won-level accuracy. Treat estimated_loss_amount as modeled baseline-relative loss, not audited financial damage.
performance_framing.prediction_file_note: Prediction CSVs are same-day/retrospective aggregate evaluation artifacts and include observed labels/outcomes for validation, not prospective deployment outputs. Prospective use requires forecast weather inputs.
